Show the 5 places to visit in Jaipur on a map
10:45 PM

Here are 5 top places to visit in Jaipur, in an easy route order starting with the Amber Fort side and ending in the old city. Spots are approximate.

Amber Fort: the big hilltop fort, best in the morning
Jal Mahal: lake palace, a quick photo stop on the way back
Hawa Mahal: the pink palace with the honeycomb front
City Palace: royal rooms and courtyards in the old city
Jantar Mantar: old stone sun clocks, right next to City Palace

India's real GDP growth over the last 5 financial years went from a COVID dip of -5.8% in FY21 to a rebound of 9.7% in FY22, then 7.6%, 9.2% and 6.5% in FY25. These are rounded figures from official estimates, which get revised. I don't have the latest FY26 number, so check the Ministry of Statistics for that.
